204		land_rig.visible = want == &"land"
205		sprite.visible = want == &""

208			if clip != &"":
209				anim.stop()
210			clip = &""
211			clip_held = false
212			return

214			# Paused or locked with a clip selected: freeze it; it re-enters on the first enabled tick.
215			if clip != want and clip != &"":
216				anim.stop()
217			clip = want
218			if anim.is_playing():
219				anim.pause()
220			clip_held = true
221			return
222		var entry := want != clip or clip_held or (want == &"land" and just_landed)
223		if not entry:
224			return   # steady tick, including SCOOT-A <-> SCOOT-B: no call

228		if clip == &"land" and want == &"scoot" and not clip_held:

236		clip_held = false

239		## The synced entry time: LAND (8 - land_ticks) / 60, SCOOT (tick % 14) / 60.
240		if c == &"land":
241			return float(T.LAND_TICKS - land_ticks) / CLIP_FPS

extends CharacterBody2D
## The jelly. Movement model from the walker-jumpman starter (unchanged rules: fixed jump,
## coyote and buffer ticks, a held jump never re-jumps); sizes from CHARACTER-SHEET.md.

const Tuning = preload("res://features/player/tuning.gd")
const T = preload("res://game/slice_tuning.gd")
const POSES := ["IDLE", "BORED", "SCOOT-A", "SCOOT-B", "ANTIC", "RISE", "FALL", "LAND", "WORRY", "SPLAT", "RESPAWN", "CELEBRATE"]
## CHARACTER-SHEET.md gives the crouch, landing squash and bored slump the low box. In this build
## the crouch (ANTIC) is a visual-only pose shown after takeoff, so it keeps the standing box:
## a low box in the air let the jelly rise 14 px higher into a ceiling (starter low-ceiling check).
const LOW_POSES := ["LAND", "BORED"]
const STANDING := Vector2(52, 58)   # CHARACTER-SHEET.md: bottom-aligned, centred
const LOW := Vector2(52, 44)
var tuning = Tuning.new()
var enabled: bool = false
var tick: int = 0
var last_floor_tick: int = -1000
var jump_request_tick: int = -1000
var opportunity_consumed: bool = false
var require_jump_release: bool = true
var require_axis_release: bool = true   # a direction held through a lock is ignored until released
var ignore_press_through_frame: int = -1
var facing: float = 1.0
var jumps: int = 0
var was_grounded: bool = true
var just_landed: bool = false
var just_hopped: bool = false
var box: Vector2 = STANDING
var collider: CollisionShape2D
var sprite: Sprite2D
var textures: Dictionary = {}
var pose: String = "IDLE"
var override_pose: String = ""   # set by the session: SPLAT, RESPAWN or CELEBRATE
var worried: bool = false        # set by the session: a shadow is growing over this plate
var idle_ticks: int = 0
var land_ticks: int = 0
var hop_ticks: int = -1          # ticks since takeoff; -1 when the jelly did not hop
var sound: Node                  # the session's sound-event entry point
var test_control: bool = false
var test_axis: float = 0.0
var test_jump_pressed: bool = false
var test_jump_held: bool = false

func _ready() -> void:
	name = "Player"
	collision_layer = 2
	collision_mask = 1
	floor_snap_length = 2.0
	collider = CollisionShape2D.new()
	collider.shape = RectangleShape2D.new()
	add_child(collider)
	set_box(STANDING)
	for p in POSES:
		textures[p] = load("res://assets/art/CHAR-%s.png" % p)
	# Every pose's bottom edge is at y 811-812 of its 1024 canvas: anchor at bottom centre.
	sprite = Sprite2D.new()
	sprite.centered = false
	sprite.offset = -T.JELLY_ANCHOR
	sprite.scale = Vector2.ONE * T.JELLY_SCALE
	sprite.texture_filter = CanvasItem.TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS
	add_child(sprite)
	_update_pose()

func set_box(size: Vector2) -> void:
	box = size
	(collider.shape as RectangleShape2D).size = size
	collider.position = Vector2(0, -size.y / 2.0)

func reset_at(spawn: Vector2) -> void:
	position = spawn
	velocity = Vector2.ZERO
	last_floor_tick = -1000
	jumps = 0
	was_grounded = true   # placing the jelly on a plate is not a landing
	just_landed = false
	just_hopped = false
	idle_ticks = 0
	land_ticks = 0
	hop_ticks = -1
	require_fresh_press()
	_update_pose()

func require_fresh_press() -> void:
	## The next hop needs a new jump press: a held key must be released first, and a press
	## that arrived with the key that changed the state (skip, restart, unpause) is ignored.
	## A held direction is ignored the same way, so the skip or restart key never moves the jelly.
	require_jump_release = true
	require_axis_release = true
	jump_request_tick = -1000
	opportunity_consumed = false
	test_jump_pressed = false
	ignore_press_through_frame = Engine.get_physics_frames() + 1

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	just_landed = false
	just_hopped = false
	if not enabled:
		_update_pose()
		return
	tick += 1
	var axis := test_axis if test_control else Input.get_axis("move_left", "move_right")
	if is_zero_approx(axis):
		require_axis_release = false
	elif require_axis_release:
		axis = 0.0
	var held := test_jump_held if test_control else Input.is_action_pressed("jump")
	var pressed := test_jump_pressed if test_control else Input.is_action_just_pressed("jump")
	test_jump_pressed = false
	if pressed and Engine.get_physics_frames() <= ignore_press_through_frame:
		pressed = false
	idle_ticks = 0 if (not is_zero_approx(axis) or held or pressed) else idle_ticks + 1
	if not held:
		require_jump_release = false
	if is_on_floor() and velocity.y >= 0.0:
		last_floor_tick = tick
		opportunity_consumed = false
	if pressed and not require_jump_release:
		jump_request_tick = tick
	var rate: float = tuning.acceleration if not is_zero_approx(axis) else tuning.deceleration
	velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, axis * tuning.speed, rate * delta)
	if not is_zero_approx(axis):
		facing = signf(axis)
	velocity.y = minf(velocity.y + tuning.gravity * delta, tuning.terminal_velocity)
	if not opportunity_consumed and tick - last_floor_tick <= tuning.coyote_ticks and tick - jump_request_tick <= tuning.buffer_ticks:
		velocity.y = tuning.jump_velocity
		opportunity_consumed = true
		jump_request_tick = -1000
		jumps += 1
		just_hopped = true
		hop_ticks = 0
		# Grounded (or coyote) -> airborne after a fresh jump press: the only place SFX-HOP plays.
		if sound:
			sound.play("SFX-HOP")
	move_and_slide()
	var grounded := is_on_floor()
	if grounded and not was_grounded:
		just_landed = true
		land_ticks = T.LAND_TICKS
		hop_ticks = -1
	elif land_ticks > 0:
		land_ticks -= 1
	if not grounded and hop_ticks >= 0:
		hop_ticks += 1
	was_grounded = grounded
	_update_pose()

func choose_pose() -> String:
	## CHARACTER-SHEET.md pose table. Worried always overrides bored.
	if override_pose != "":
		return override_pose
	if not was_grounded:
		if hop_ticks >= 0 and hop_ticks <= T.ANTIC_TICKS:
			return "ANTIC"   # visual only: shown at takeoff, no input delay
		return "RISE" if velocity.y < 0.0 else "FALL"
	if land_ticks > 0:
		return "LAND"
	if absf(velocity.x) > 8.0:
		return "SCOOT-A" if (tick / T.ticks(T.SCOOT_FRAME)) % 2 == 0 else "SCOOT-B"
	if worried:
		return "WORRY"
	if idle_ticks >= T.ticks(T.BORED_DELAY):
		return "BORED"
	return "IDLE"

func _update_pose() -> void:
	pose = choose_pose()
	sprite.texture = textures[pose]
	sprite.flip_h = facing < 0.0   # drawn facing right; keeps the last direction moved
	var wanted := LOW if pose in LOW_POSES else STANDING
	if wanted != box:
		set_box(wanted)
	_update_visuals()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- A7 visual layer
## CHANGE-BRIEF.md (A7), "Scene, authority and states" and Revision 1. Everything below only reads
## gameplay state (pose, facing, tick, land_ticks, just_landed, enabled); it never writes it.
## The AnimationPlayer alone writes ScootSprite.frame and the rig pivots; this code writes only the
## facing mirror, the three visibility flags and the playback calls.

const VISUALS_SCENE = preload("res://features/player/player_visuals.tscn")
## Pose -> clip. Every other pose shows the original sprite with no clip.
const POSE_CLIPS := {"LAND": &"land", "SCOOT-A": &"scoot", "SCOOT-B": &"scoot"}
const CLIP_FPS := 60.0   # both clips: step 1/60 s, one physics tick per timeline frame

var visuals: Node2D
var facing_pivot: Node2D
var scoot_node: Node2D
var land_rig: Node2D
var anim: AnimationPlayer
var clip: StringName = &""        # the clip this code last entered, or "" for the original sprite
var clip_held: bool = false       # the player was disabled with a clip selected: re-enter when enabled

func _update_visuals() -> void:
	if visuals == null:
		visuals = VISUALS_SCENE.instantiate()
		add_child(visuals)
		facing_pivot = visuals.get_node("FacingPivot")
		scoot_node = visuals.get_node("FacingPivot/Scoot")
		land_rig = visuals.get_node("FacingPivot/LandRig")
		anim = visuals.get_node("AnimationPlayer")
	facing_pivot.transform = Transform2D(Vector2(facing, 0), Vector2(0, 1), Vector2.ZERO)
	var want: StringName = POSE_CLIPS.get(pose, &"")
	scoot_node.visible = want == &"scoot"
	land_rig.visible = want == &"land"
	sprite.visible = want == &""
	if want == &"":
		# Leaving a clip (hop, walk-off, override, tick-8 hand-off, reset): stop it.
		if clip != &"":
			anim.stop()
		clip = &""
		clip_held = false
		return
	if not enabled:
		# Paused or locked with a clip selected: freeze it; it re-enters on the first enabled tick.
		if clip != want and clip != &"":
			anim.stop()
		clip = want
		if anim.is_playing():
			anim.pause()
		clip_held = true
		return
	var entry := want != clip or clip_held or (want == &"land" and just_landed)
	if not entry:
		return   # steady tick, including SCOOT-A <-> SCOOT-B: no call
	if clip != &"" and clip != want:
		anim.stop()
	anim.play(want)
	if clip == &"land" and want == &"scoot" and not clip_held:
		# Direct LAND -> SCOOT switch: the AnimationPlayer was already playing land, and its own update
		# later this tick adds 1/60 (fd4d855). Seek one tick earlier on the loop so it lands on the synced time
		# (probe H3, prompt-5e).
		anim.seek(fposmod(_clip_time(want) - 1.0 / CLIP_FPS, anim.get_animation(&"scoot").length), true)
	else:
		anim.seek(_clip_time(want), true)
	clip = want
	clip_held = false

func _clip_time(c: StringName) -> float:
	## The synced entry time: LAND (8 - land_ticks) / 60, SCOOT (tick % 14) / 60.
	if c == &"land":
		return float(T.LAND_TICKS - land_ticks) / CLIP_FPS
	return float(tick % (2 * T.ticks(T.SCOOT_FRAME))) / CLIP_FPS

1	extends SceneTree
2	## A7 Step 2: behaviour pins of the existing game, before any clip, sheet or visual scene exists.
3	## Real game (session.gd) and real key events through Input.parse_input_event only; every press and
4	## release is scheduled by physics tick. Scripted input; this is not human playtesting. Prints only.
5	## Optional: `-- --baseline-only` (after the script's "--") runs only the baseline run (Movie Maker replay).
6	const Game = preload("res://game/session.gd")
7	const SLOT := 600        # each run starts on a physics frame that is a multiple of this (same tick at every rate)
8	const SETTLE := 10       # grounded, PLAYING and IDLE this many ticks before the stationary hop press
9	const JUMP_KEY := KEY_SPACE
10	const RIGHT_KEY := KEY_D
11	const LEFT_KEY := KEY_A
12	const LOW := Vector2(52, 44)
13	const STANDING := Vector2(52, 58)
14	
15	## The 12 cases in CHANGE-BRIEF.md, "Jump interrupt predictions". k: physics tick (relative to touchdown)
16	## on which the fresh press is read. hop: tick the hop fires and ANTIC shows. land0: LAND shown at 0.
17	## idle8: IDLE shown at 8.
18	const CASES := [
19		{"boundary": 0, "column": "before", "k": -1, "hop": 1, "land0": true, "predicted": "-1: buffer; LAND at 0, ANTIC at 1"},
20		{"boundary": 0, "column": "on", "k": 0, "hop": 1, "land0": true, "predicted": "0: buffer; LAND at 0, ANTIC at 1"},
21		{"boundary": 0, "column": "after", "k": 1, "hop": 1, "predicted": "1: ANTIC at 1"},
22		{"boundary": 2, "column": "before", "k": 1, "hop": 1, "predicted": "1: ANTIC at 1"},
23		{"boundary": 2, "column": "on", "k": 2, "hop": 2, "predicted": "2: ANTIC at 2"},
24		{"boundary": 2, "column": "after", "k": 3, "hop": 3, "predicted": "3: ANTIC at 3"},
25		{"boundary": 4, "column": "before", "k": 3, "hop": 3, "predicted": "3: ANTIC at 3"},
26		{"boundary": 4, "column": "on", "k": 4, "hop": 4, "predicted": "4: ANTIC at 4"},
27		{"boundary": 4, "column": "after", "k": 5, "hop": 5, "predicted": "5: ANTIC at 5"},
28		{"boundary": 8, "column": "before", "k": 7, "hop": 7, "predicted": "7: ANTIC at 7"},
29		{"boundary": 8, "column": "on", "k": 8, "hop": 8, "predicted": "8: ANTIC at 8 instead of IDLE"},
30		{"boundary": 8, "column": "after", "k": 9, "hop": 9, "idle8": true, "predicted": "9: IDLE at 8, then ANTIC at 9"},
31	]
32	
33	var game: Node2D
34	var hook: Node
35	var run_name := ""
36	var run_first_logged := false
37	var by_tick: Dictionary = {}     # physics frame -> row of the current run
38	var reads: Array[int] = []       # physics frames on which the jump action was just pressed
39	var checks := 0
40	var failures := 0
41	var digest: HashingContext
42	var digest_lines := 0
43	
44	class TickHook extends Node:
45		## Runs after the player (priority 0), session (10) and effects driver (20) in every physics tick.
46		var on_tick: Callable
47		func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
48			on_tick.call()
49	
50	func _initialize() -> void:
51		call_deferred("run")
52	
53	func now() -> int:
54		return Engine.get_physics_frames()
55	
56	func check(id: String, passed: bool, observed: Dictionary) -> void:
57		checks += 1
58		if not passed:
59			failures += 1
60		print("CHECK " + JSON.stringify({"id": id, "status": "PASS" if passed else "FAIL", "observed": observed}))
61	
62	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- input (real key events only)
63	
64	var pending: Array = []          # [code, pressed, read_tick]: sent at the end of physics frame read_tick - 1
65	
66	func key_for(read_tick: int, code: Key, pressed: bool) -> void:
67		## Schedules a key event so the player's _physics_process reads it on physics frame read_tick.
68		## Must be called no later than the start of frame read_tick - 1.
69		if now() > read_tick - 1:
70			check("harness-input-scheduled-in-time", false, {"read_tick": read_tick, "now": now(), "key": OS.get_keycode_string(code)})
71		pending.append([code, pressed, read_tick])
72	
73	func send(code: Key, pressed: bool, read_tick: int) -> void:
74		## The game's InputMap holds InputEventKey events with physical_keycode (session.gd lines 73-76).
75		var event := InputEventKey.new()
76		event.keycode = code
77		event.physical_keycode = code
78		event.pressed = pressed
79		Input.parse_input_event(event)
80		# parse_input_event buffers the event (Input.use_accumulated_input). Without a flush it is applied at
81		# the next main-loop iteration, which is 1 or 2 physics ticks away depending on the render rate. With
82		# the flush it is applied now, during physics frame now(); Godot then reports it as just pressed on
83		# frame now() + 1, which is why events are sent at the end of the frame before the reading frame.
84		Input.flush_buffered_events()
85		print("INPUT %s tick=%d frame=%d key=%s pressed=%s read_tick=%d" % [run_name, now(), Engine.get_process_frames(), OS.get_keycode_string(code), pressed, read_tick])
86	
87	func until(t: int) -> void:
88		## Returns at the start of physics frame t, before any node's _physics_process in that frame.
89		while now() < t:
90			await physics_frame
91	
92	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- per-tick log
93	
94	func _log_tick() -> void:
95		_log_row()
96		# After every game node has run this frame: send the events to be read on the next frame.
97		var keep: Array = []
98		for e in pending:
99			if int(e[2]) == now() + 1:
100				send(e[0], e[1], e[2])
101			elif int(e[2]) <= now():
102				check("harness-input-sent-in-time", false, {"read_tick": e[2], "now": now()})
103			else:
104				keep.append(e)
105		pending = keep
106	
107	func _log_row() -> void:
108		if run_name == "" or not is_instance_valid(game) or game.player == null:
109			return
110		var p = game.player
111		var t := now()
112		var f := Engine.get_process_frames()
113		if not run_first_logged:
114			run_first_logged = true
115			print("RUN %s first_tick=%d first_frame=%d frames_drawn=%d" % [run_name, t, f, Engine.get_frames_drawn()])
116		var tex: String = p.sprite.texture.resource_path.get_file() if p.sprite.texture else "none"
117		var row := {"tick": t, "frame": f, "ptick": p.tick, "pose": p.pose, "land_ticks": p.land_ticks,
118			"just_landed": p.just_landed, "just_hopped": p.just_hopped, "box": p.box, "facing": p.facing,
119			"flip_h": p.sprite.flip_h, "tex": tex, "floor": p.is_on_floor(), "vx": roundi(p.velocity.x),
120			"state": game.state}
121		by_tick[t] = row
122		var head := "PIN %s tick=%d" % [run_name, t]
123		var tail := "ptick=%d pose=%s land_ticks=%d just_landed=%s box=%dx%d facing=%s flip_h=%s tex=%s floor=%s vx=%d" % [
124			row.ptick, row.pose, row.land_ticks, row.just_landed, int(row.box.x), int(row.box.y),
125			str(row.facing), row.flip_h, tex, row.floor, row.vx]
126		print("%s frame=%d %s" % [head, f, tail])
127		# Digest of the PIN lines without frame= (render frames differ by rate by design), to compare rates.
128		digest.update((head + " " + tail + "\n").to_utf8_buffer())
129		digest_lines += 1
130		if Input.is_action_just_pressed("jump"):
131			reads.append(t)
132			print("READ %s tick=%d ptick=%d jump_just_pressed=true" % [run_name, t, row.ptick])
133		if p.just_hopped:
134			print("HOP %s tick=%d ptick=%d" % [run_name, t, row.ptick])
135	
136	func row_at(t: int) -> Dictionary:
137		return by_tick.get(t, {})
138	
139	func pose_at(t: int) -> String:
140		return str(row_at(t).get("pose", "?"))
141	
142	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- runs
143	
144	func end_digest() -> void:
145		if run_name != "":
146			print("PINDIGEST %s lines=%d sha256_without_frame=%s" % [run_name, digest_lines, digest.finish().hex_encode()])
147	
148	func start_run(name: String) -> void:
149		## A fresh game, added at the start of a physics frame that is a multiple of SLOT.
150		end_digest()
151		digest = HashingContext.new()
152		digest.start(HashingContext.HASH_SHA256)
153		digest_lines = 0
154		if is_instance_valid(game):
155			run_name = ""
156			game.queue_free()
157			await process_frame
158			await process_frame
159		await until((now() / SLOT + 1) * SLOT)
160		by_tick.clear()
161		reads.clear()
162		pending.clear()
163		run_first_logged = false
164		run_name = name
165		game = Game.new()
166		game.test_mode = true
167		root.add_child(game)
168	
169	func wait_ready() -> int:
170		## Waits until the session is PLAYING and the jelly has been grounded and IDLE for SETTLE ticks.
171		## Returns at the start of frame now(); the hop press is then read on frame now() + 1.
172		var streak := 0
173		var guard := 0
174		while guard < SLOT:
175			await physics_frame
176			guard += 1
177			var r := row_at(now() - 1)
178			if not r.is_empty() and r.state == Game.State.PLAYING and r.floor and r.pose == "IDLE":
179				streak += 1
180			else:
181				streak = 0
182			if streak >= SETTLE:
183				return now()
184		return -1
185	
186	func stationary_hop() -> int:
187		## Returns the physics frame on which the stationary hop press is read.
188		var ready := await wait_ready()
189		if ready < 0:
190			return -1
191		var h := ready + 1
192		key_for(h, JUMP_KEY, true)
193		key_for(h + 2, JUMP_KEY, false)
194		return h
195	
196	func first_tick_where(from: int, to: int, field: String) -> int:
197		for t in range(from, to + 1):
198			if row_at(t).get(field, false):
199				return t
200		return -1
201	
202	func run() -> void:
203		hook = TickHook.new()
204		hook.name = "PinTickHook"
205		hook.process_physics_priority = 1000
206		hook.on_tick = _log_tick
207		root.add_child(hook)
208		var baseline_only := "--baseline-only" in OS.get_cmdline_user_args()
209		print("A7 PINS: engine=%s baseline_only=%s physics_ticks_per_second=%d" % [Engine.get_version_info().string, baseline_only, Engine.physics_ticks_per_second])
210		var d := await baseline()
211		if not baseline_only:
212			await interrupts(d)
213		end_digest()
214		run_name = ""
215		print("A7 PINS: %d checks / %d failures" % [checks, failures])
216		if is_instance_valid(game):
217			game.queue_free()
218		hook.queue_free()
219		for i in range(30):
220			await process_frame
221		quit(1 if failures else 0)
222	
223	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- baseline
224	
225	func baseline() -> int:
226		await start_run("baseline")
227		var h := await stationary_hop()
228		# Touchdown: the tick the player reports just_landed.
229		var t0 := -1
230		while t0 < 0 and now() < h + 200:
231			await physics_frame
232			if row_at(now() - 1).get("just_landed", false):
233				t0 = now() - 1
234		check("baseline-harness-ready-and-press-read-on-hop-tick", h > 0 and reads == [h] and row_at(h).get("just_hopped", false),
235			{"press_tick": h, "jump_read_ticks": reads.duplicate(), "hop_on_press_tick": row_at(h).get("just_hopped", false)})
236		print("BASELINE press_tick=%d touchdown_tick=%d press_to_touchdown=%d" % [h, t0, t0 - h])
237		# Settle in IDLE, then scoot right, stop, scoot left, stop.
238		var right_on := t0 + 30
239		var right_off := right_on + 20
240		var left_on := right_off + 25
241		var left_off := left_on + 36
242		var end := left_off + 25
243		key_for(right_on, RIGHT_KEY, true)
244		key_for(right_off, RIGHT_KEY, false)
245		key_for(left_on, LEFT_KEY, true)
246		key_for(left_off, LEFT_KEY, false)
247		await until(end + 1)   # row for `end` is complete
248		var hop_window := range(h, right_on)
249		# 1. Pose order through the hop.
250		var seq: Array[String] = []
251		for t in hop_window:
252			if seq.is_empty() or seq.back() != pose_at(t):
253				seq.append(pose_at(t))
254		check("baseline-1-hop-pose-order", seq == ["ANTIC", "RISE", "FALL", "LAND", "IDLE"], {"sequence": seq, "from_tick": h, "to_tick": right_on - 1})
255		# 2. just_landed on exactly one tick.
256		var landed: Array[int] = []
257		for t in hop_window:
258			if row_at(t).get("just_landed", false):
259				landed.append(t)
260		check("baseline-2-just-landed-once", landed.size() == 1, {"just_landed_ticks": landed})
261		# 3. LAND lasts exactly 8 ticks, starting on the just_landed tick.
262		var land: Array[int] = []
263		for t in hop_window:
264			if pose_at(t) == "LAND":
265				land.append(t)
266		var want_land: Array[int] = []
267		for t in range(t0, t0 + 8):
268			want_land.append(t)
269		check("baseline-3-land-8-ticks-from-just-landed", land == want_land and landed == [t0], {"land_ticks": land, "touchdown_tick": t0, "land_count": land.size()})
270		# 4. Box 52x44 on exactly those ticks, 52x58 around them.
271		var bad_box: Array = []
272		var low_ticks: Array[int] = []
273		for t in hop_window:
274			var b: Vector2 = row_at(t).get("box", Vector2.ZERO)
275			if b == LOW:
276				low_ticks.append(t)
277			var want: Vector2 = LOW if t in land else STANDING
278			if b != want:
279				bad_box.append({"tick": t, "box": str(b), "pose": pose_at(t)})
280		check("baseline-4-low-box-exactly-on-land", bad_box.is_empty() and low_ticks == want_land, {"low_box_ticks": low_ticks, "mismatches": bad_box})
281		# Scenario validity (harness): the scoots stay on the starting plate and go both ways.
282		var off_floor: Array[int] = []
283		for t in range(right_on, end + 1):
284			if not row_at(t).get("floor", false):
285				off_floor.append(t)
286		# Scoot segments: maximal runs of consecutive ticks with a SCOOT pose.
287		var segments: Array = []
288		var phase_bad: Array = []
289		for t in range(right_on, end + 1):
290			var r := row_at(t)
291			var pose := pose_at(t)
292			if pose.begins_with("SCOOT"):
293				var want_pose := "SCOOT-A" if posmod(int(r.ptick), 14) < 7 else "SCOOT-B"
294				if pose != want_pose:
295					phase_bad.append({"tick": t, "ptick": r.ptick, "pose": pose, "expected": want_pose})
296				if segments.is_empty() or segments.back().last != t - 1:
297					segments.append({"first": t, "last": t, "facing": r.facing})
298				else:
299					segments.back().last = t
300		check("baseline-harness-scoot-on-plate-both-ways", off_floor.is_empty() and segments.size() == 2 and segments[0].facing > 0 and segments[1].facing < 0, {"off_floor_ticks": off_floor, "segments": segments})
301		# 5a. SCOOT-A exactly when (player.tick % 14) < 7.
302		check("baseline-5a-scoot-a-when-tick-mod-14-below-7", phase_bad.is_empty() and segments.size() == 2, {"mismatches": phase_bad})
303		# 5b. Alternate every 7 player ticks: every run of one cell that is not cut by a segment edge lasts 7 ticks,
304		# and the player tick advances by one each physics tick inside a segment.
305		var interior: Array = []
306		var edge_runs: Array = []
307		var ptick_gaps: Array = []
308		for s in segments:
309			var runs: Array = []
310			for t in range(s.first, s.last + 1):
311				if t > s.first and int(row_at(t).ptick) != int(row_at(t - 1).ptick) + 1:
312					ptick_gaps.append(t)
313				if runs.is_empty() or runs.back().pose != pose_at(t):
314					runs.append({"pose": pose_at(t), "first": t, "len": 1})
315				else:
316					runs.back().len += 1
317			for i in range(runs.size()):
318				if i == 0 or i == runs.size() - 1:
319					edge_runs.append(runs[i])
320				else:
321					interior.append(runs[i])
322		var interior_ok := interior.size() >= 2
323		for r in interior:
324			interior_ok = interior_ok and r.len == 7
325		check("baseline-5b-scoot-alternates-every-7-ticks", interior_ok and ptick_gaps.is_empty(), {"interior_runs": interior, "edge_runs": edge_runs, "ptick_gaps": ptick_gaps})
326		# 6. flip_h exactly when facing < 0, on every tick of the run.
327		var flip_bad: Array = []
328		var ticks := by_tick.keys()
329		ticks.sort()
330		for t in ticks:
331			var r: Dictionary = by_tick[t]
332			if bool(r.flip_h) != (float(r.facing) < 0.0):
333				flip_bad.append({"tick": t, "facing": r.facing, "flip_h": r.flip_h})
334		check("baseline-6-flip-h-iff-facing-negative", flip_bad.is_empty() and ticks.size() > 0, {"ticks_checked": ticks.size(), "mismatches": flip_bad})
335		return t0 - h
336	
337	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- interrupt replays
338	
339	func replay(k: int, d: int) -> Dictionary:
340		await start_run("interrupt_k%+d" % k)
341		var h := await stationary_hop()
342		var t0e := h + d
343		var press := t0e + k
344		key_for(press, JUMP_KEY, true)       # fresh: the stationary press was released at h + 2
345		key_for(press + 2, JUMP_KEY, false)
346		await until(t0e + 21)
347		var t0 := first_tick_where(h + 1, t0e + 20, "just_landed")
348		var hop := first_tick_where(t0e - 2, t0e + 20, "just_hopped")   # the case hop, not the stationary one
349		var timeline: Array[String] = []
350		for rel in range(-2, 13):
351			var r := row_at(t0e + rel)
352			timeline.append("%d:%s/%d/%s" % [rel, pose_at(t0e + rel), int(r.get("land_ticks", -1)), "hop" if r.get("just_hopped", false) else ("landed" if r.get("just_landed", false) else "-")])
353		print("TIMELINE interrupt_k%+d (rel:pose/land_ticks/event) %s" % [k, " ".join(timeline)])
354		check("interrupt-k%+d-harness-same-touchdown-and-press-read" % k, t0 == t0e and press in reads and h in reads,
355			{"stationary_press_tick": h, "expected_touchdown": t0e, "observed_touchdown": t0, "case_press_tick": press, "jump_read_ticks": reads.duplicate()})
356		return {"t0": t0e, "t0_observed": t0, "press_rel": press - t0e, "read_rel": (press - t0e) if press in reads else null,
357			"hop_rel": (hop - t0e) if hop >= 0 else null, "pose0": pose_at(t0e), "pose8": pose_at(t0e + 8),
358			"poses": timeline}
359	
360	func interrupts(d: int) -> void:
361		var results := {}
362		for k in [-1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9]:
363			results[k] = await replay(k, d)
364		for c in CASES:
365			var r: Dictionary = results[c.k]
366			var hop_rel = r.hop_rel
367			var antic_at_hop := hop_rel != null and pose_at_rel(r, int(c.hop)) == "ANTIC"
368			var ok: bool = r.read_rel == c.k and hop_rel == c.hop and antic_at_hop
369			if c.get("land0", false):
370				ok = ok and r.pose0 == "LAND" and int(c.k) < int(hop_rel if hop_rel != null else -99)
371			if c.get("idle8", false):
372				ok = ok and r.pose8 == "IDLE"
373			var observed := {"predicted": c.predicted, "press_read_rel": r.read_rel, "hop_rel": hop_rel,
374				"pose_at_0": r.pose0, "pose_at_hop_prediction": pose_at_rel(r, int(c.hop)), "pose_at_8": r.pose8,
375				"timeline": r.poses}
376			print("CASE boundary=%d %s k=%+d predicted=\"%s\" observed: read=%s hop=%s pose0=%s pose%d=%s pose8=%s" % [
377				c.boundary, c.column, c.k, c.predicted, str(r.read_rel), str(hop_rel), r.pose0, c.hop, pose_at_rel(r, int(c.hop)), r.pose8])
378			check("interrupt-boundary-%d-%s-k%+d" % [c.boundary, c.column, c.k], ok, observed)
379	
380	func pose_at_rel(r: Dictionary, rel: int) -> String:
381		# The timeline entries are "rel:pose/land_ticks/event" for rel -2..12.
382		for e in r.poses:
383			if e.begins_with("%d:" % rel):
384				return e.split(":")[1].split("/")[0]
385		return "?"

87	func _build_level() -> void:
88		var width := T.level_width()
89		# Room: static, behind everything, fixed to the screen (no parallax unless approved).
90		var room_layer := CanvasLayer.new()
91		room_layer.layer = -10
92		add_child(room_layer)
93		var room := _sprite("ENV-ROOM.png", 1.0)
94		room.centered = false
95		room.texture_filter = CanvasItem.TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR
96		room_layer.add_child(room)
97		# Table front: repeats every 1376 * 0.3378 = 465 px; its top edge is the table top.
98		var step := 1376.0 * T.TABLE_SCALE
99		var x := -step
100		while x < width + step:
101			var table := _sprite("ENV-TABLE.png", T.TABLE_SCALE)
102			table.centered = false
103			table.position = Vector2(x, T.TABLE_TOP)
104			table.z_index = -5
105			add_child(table)
106			x += step
107		_add_solid(Rect2(-64, T.TABLE_TOP, width + 128, 200))   # table top: the floor
108		_add_solid(Rect2(-64, -400, 64, 1120))                  # left end wall
109		_add_solid(Rect2(width, -400, 64, 1120))                # right end wall
110		# Plates: sprite plus a solid box whose top is the landing surface.
111		var lefts := T.plate_lefts()
112		var land_y := T.plate_landing_y()
113		var half := T.plate_landing_half_width()
114		for i in range(lefts.size()):
115			var center: float = lefts[i] + T.plate_width() / 2.0
116			var plate := _sprite("ENV-PLATE.png", T.PLATE_SCALE)
117			plate.centered = false
118			plate.offset = Vector2(-T.PLATE_ART_CENTER_X, -T.PLATE_ART_BOTTOM_ROW - 1.0)
119			plate.position = Vector2(center, T.TABLE_TOP)
120			plate.z_index = -2
121			add_child(plate)
122			var body := _add_solid(Rect2(center - half, land_y, half * 2.0, T.TABLE_TOP - land_y))
123			plates.append({"index": i, "left": lefts[i], "center": center, "body": body})
124			# One fork per plate that has one (SLICE-BRIEF.md §5).
125			var cycle = T.FORK_CYCLES[i]
126			if cycle == null:
127				forks.append(null)
128			else:
129				var fork := Fork.new()
130				fork.position = Vector2(center, land_y)
131				add_child(fork)
132				fork.setup(i, cycle)
133				forks.append(fork)
134		# Sauce in some gaps, centred in the gap, sitting on the table top.
135		for g in range(T.PLATE_GAPS.size()):
136			if not T.SAUCE_IN_GAP[g]:
137				continue
138			var gap_center: float = lefts[g] + T.plate_width() + T.PLATE_GAPS[g] / 2.0
139			var sauce := _sprite("ENV-SAUCE.png", T.SAUCE_SCALE)
140			sauce.centered = false
141			sauce.offset = Vector2(-470.0, -151.0)   # canvas centre x; bottom opaque row 150
142			sauce.position = Vector2(gap_center, T.TABLE_TOP + 2.0)
143			sauce.z_index = -1
144			add_child(sauce)
145			# Hit zone = the visible puddle body (the lower rows, ~119 px wide; the thin top edge is left out).
146			sauce_areas.append(_add_area(Rect2(gap_center - 58.0, T.TABLE_TOP - 12.0, 116.0, 14.0), 8))
147		# Dome at the far end, on the table; drawn in front of the jelly so it sits inside the glass.
148		var dome := _sprite("ENV-DOME.png", T.DOME_SCALE)
149		dome.centered = false
150		dome.offset = Vector2(-375.0, -528.0)
151		dome.position = Vector2(T.dome_left() + T.dome_width() / 2.0, T.TABLE_TOP + 1.0)
152		dome.z_index = 5
153		add_child(dome)
154		goal = _add_area(Rect2(T.dome_left() + 40.0, T.TABLE_TOP - 100.0, T.dome_width() - 80.0, 100.0), 16)

156	func _add_solid(rect: Rect2) -> StaticBody2D:
157		var body := StaticBody2D.new()
158		body.position = rect.position + rect.size / 2
159		body.collision_layer = 1
160		body.collision_mask = 2
161		var shape := RectangleShape2D.new()
162		shape.size = rect.size
163		var collision := CollisionShape2D.new()
164		collision.shape = shape
165		body.add_child(collision)
166		add_child(body)
167		return body

169	func _add_area(rect: Rect2, layer: int) -> Area2D:
170		var area := Area2D.new()
171		area.position = rect.position
172		area.collision_layer = layer
173		area.collision_mask = 2
174		var collision := CollisionShape2D.new()
175		var shape := RectangleShape2D.new()
176		shape.size = rect.size
177		collision.shape = shape
178		collision.position = rect.size / 2.0
179		area.add_child(collision)
180		add_child(area)
181		return area

186	func plate_under(x: float) -> int:
187		## Index of the plate whose landing surface is under x, or -1.
188		for p in plates:
189			if absf(x - p.center) <= T.plate_landing_half_width() + 26.0:

194	
195	func camera_target_x() -> float:
196		## Follow the jelly to the right and look ahead, so the next forks' shadows are on screen.
197		return clampf(player.position.x + T.LOOK_AHEAD, T.VIEW.x / 2.0, T.level_width() - T.VIEW.x / 2.0)

205	func _start_intro() -> void:
206		## Panel 1: eye-level pan from the dome back to the jelly. Movement is locked.
207		state = State.INTRO
208		intro_ticks = 0
209		player.enabled = false

213	func start_session() -> void:
214		## Begin play on the first plate: when the intro pan ends or is skipped, or on replay after
215		## the dome (no pan). Every fork cycle and the checkpoint reset.
216		if state == State.PLAYING:
217			return
218		if state == State.WON:
219			music.restart()   # replay: the loop starts again from the top
220		splats = 0
221		checkpoint = 0
222		jelly_plate = 0
223		prompt_shown = false
224		won_once = false
225		shake_ticks = 0
226		camera.offset = Vector2.ZERO
227		for fork in forks:
228			if fork:
229				fork.reset_cycle()
230		_begin_play(spawn_point(0))
231		_set_camera(camera_target_x(), true)

233	func _begin_play(at: Vector2) -> void:
234		state = State.PLAYING
235		timer = 0.0
236		# Area2D overlaps are physics-step snapshots. Discard pre-teleport contacts
237		# until the broadphase has observed the reset, preventing a phantom second splat.
238		contact_settle_ticks = 2
239		player.reset_at(at)
240		player.enabled = true
241		# Control returns: the checkpoint fork's safe window begins now (panel 6, failure #12).
242		if forks[checkpoint]:
243			forks[checkpoint].restart_at_safe()
244	
245	func set_paused(value: bool) -> void:
246		if value and state == State.PLAYING:
247			state = State.PAUSED
248			player.enabled = false
249		elif not value and state == State.PAUSED:
250			state = State.PLAYING
251			player.enabled = true
252			player.require_fresh_press()
253	
254	func _on_focus_lost() -> void:
255		if not test_mode:
256			set_paused(true)
257	
258	func resolve_contacts(cause: String, finished: bool) -> void:
259		## cause: "" (none), "fork" or "sauce". A failure wins over reaching the goal.
260		if state != State.PLAYING:
261			return
262		if cause != "":
263			state = State.SPLAT
264			splats += 1
265			splat_cause = cause
266			timer = T.SPLAT_TIME
267			player.enabled = false
268			player.velocity = Vector2.ZERO
269			# One splat sound per failure: hits stay off until control returns.
270			sound.play("SFX-SPLAT-FORK" if cause == "fork" else "SFX-SPLAT-SAUCE")
271			if cause == "fork":
272				shake_ticks = T.ticks(T.SHAKE_TIME)   # camera only; never on a sauce splat
273			# The jelly will re-form on the checkpoint plate: hold that fork raised until control returns.
274			if forks[checkpoint]:
275				forks[checkpoint].hold_raised()
276		elif finished:
277			state = State.WON
278			timer = 0.0
279			prompt_shown = false
280			win_from = player.position
281			player.enabled = false
282			player.velocity = Vector2.ZERO
283			if not won_once:
284				won_once = true
285				sound.play("SFX-WIN")
286	
287	func view_rect() -> Rect2:
288		return Rect2(camera.get_screen_center_position() - T.VIEW / 2.0, T.VIEW)
289	
290	func shadow_on_screen(fork) -> bool:
291		return view_rect().intersects(fork.shadow_rect())
292	
293	func _advance_forks() -> void:
294		## Forks keep their fixed rhythm during play, splat and re-form (paused, intro and win freeze them).
295		for fork in forks:
296			if fork and fork.advance() == "down":
297				# SFX-WARN (Kiran, 2026-10-03, after the second audition): the scrape plays once when the fork
298				# over the jelly's current or next plate starts descending, if that fork is on screen at that
299				# moment. Nothing plays when a shadow starts growing; the shadow alone does the warning.
300				fork.announced = shadow_on_screen(fork) and fork.plate_index in [jelly_plate, jelly_plate + 1]
301				if fork.announced:
302					on_warning(fork)
303	
304	func on_warning(_fork) -> void:
305		sound.play("SFX-WARN")   # once per strike, as the fork starts descending
306	
307	func warnings_on_screen() -> int:
308		## Forks warning (shadow growing, or striking) with any part of the shadow on screen.
309		## CHANGE-BRIEF.md music rule (Kiran, 2026-10-03): a shadow that started off screen dips
310		## the music once it is on screen, though it never plays SFX-WARN.
311		var n := 0
312		for fork in forks:
313			if fork and fork.is_warning() and shadow_on_screen(fork):
314				n += 1
315		return n
316	
317	func music_target() -> String:
318		match state:
319			State.INTRO:
320				return "intro"
321			State.PAUSED:
322				return "pause"
323			State.WON:
324				return "end_quiet" if prompt_shown else "win_fade"
325			State.SPLAT, State.REFORM:
326				return "splat"
327		return "warning" if warnings_on_screen() > 0 else "normal"
328	
329	func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
330		if state in [State.PLAYING, State.SPLAT, State.REFORM]:
331			_advance_forks()
332		match state:
333			State.INTRO:
334				intro_ticks += 1
335				var k := clampf(float(intro_ticks) / float(T.ticks(T.INTRO_PAN)), 0.0, 1.0)
336				var from := T.level_width() - T.VIEW.x / 2.0
337				camera.position.x = lerpf(from, camera_target_x(), ease(k, -2.0))   # ease in-out
338				if k >= 1.0:
339					start_session()
340			State.WON:
341				# Slide into the dome, then wait for the prompt (panel 7).
342				timer += delta
343				var k := clampf(timer / T.WIN_SLIDE, 0.0, 1.0)
344				var dome_center := Vector2(T.dome_left() + T.dome_width() / 2.0, T.TABLE_TOP)
345				player.position = win_from.lerp(dome_center, 1.0 - (1.0 - k) * (1.0 - k))
346				if timer >= T.PROMPT_DELAY:
347					prompt_shown = true
348			State.SPLAT:
349				timer -= delta
350				if timer <= 0.0:
351					# Re-form on the last safe plate; hits stay off and input stays locked.
352					state = State.REFORM
353					timer = T.REFORM_TIME
354					player.reset_at(spawn_point(checkpoint))
355					jelly_plate = checkpoint
356			State.REFORM:
357				timer -= delta
358				if timer <= 0.0:
359					_begin_play(spawn_point(checkpoint))
360			State.PLAYING:
361				timer += delta
362				var cause := ""
363				for sauce in sauce_areas:
364					if sauce.overlaps_body(player):
365						cause = "sauce"
366				for fork in forks:
367					if fork and fork.hit_area.overlaps_body(player):
368						cause = "fork"
369				if contact_settle_ticks > 0:
370					contact_settle_ticks -= 1
371				else:
372					resolve_contacts(cause, goal.overlaps_body(player))
373				if state == State.PLAYING and player.just_landed:
374					# Airborne -> grounded, and not into sauce (that is a splat). Respawn is not a landing.
375					sound.play("SFX-LAND")
376					var p := plate_under(player.position.x)
377					if p >= 0:
378						checkpoint = p
379		if state != State.INTRO:
380			camera.position.x = camera_target_x()   # smoothing gives the glide back on respawn
381		if shake_ticks > 0:
382			shake_ticks -= 1
383			var amount := T.SHAKE_PX * float(shake_ticks) / float(T.ticks(T.SHAKE_TIME))
384			camera.offset = Vector2(shake_rng.randf_range(-1, 1), shake_rng.randf_range(-1, 1)) * amount
385		else:
386			camera.offset = Vector2.ZERO
387		music.set_target(music_target())
388		var under := plate_under(player.position.x)
389		if under >= 0 and player.is_on_floor() and state == State.PLAYING:
390			jelly_plate = under
391		player.worried = state == State.PLAYING and under >= 0 and forks[under] != null and forks[under].phase() == Fork.Phase.SHADOW
392		player.override_pose = {State.SPLAT: "SPLAT", State.REFORM: "RESPAWN", State.WON: "CELEBRATE"}.get(state, "")
393		if is_instance_valid(hud):
394			hud.queue_redraw()
395	
396	func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
397		if not (event is InputEventKey) or event.echo or not event.pressed:
398			return
399		# M and N only toggle mute; muting never changes game state, so they never skip or restart.
400		if event.is_action_pressed("mute_all") or event.is_action_pressed("mute_music"):
401			toggle_mute(event.is_action_pressed("mute_all"))
402			return
403		if state == State.INTRO:
404			start_session()   # any key skips the pan; the skip key never hops (fresh press rule)
405		elif state == State.WON:
406			if prompt_shown:
407				start_session()   # any key plays again, on the first plate, with no intro pan
408		elif event.is_action_pressed("pause"):
409			set_paused(state != State.PAUSED)
410	
411	func toggle_mute(all: bool) -> void:
412		music.toggle_mute(all)
413

2	## Fixture for the Effect A frame strip (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, Effect A, "The frame strip").
3	## Frame 10: the plate puff and the table puff fire together. With `retrigger` on, a third puff
4	## fires at frame 15 beside the table one (5 frames, 0.167 s later at 30 fps: the scoot-off case).
5	## Only sets `emitting`: every effect setting lives in res://effects/land_puff.tscn, and the fixed
6	## seeds are set on the instances in land_puff_preview.tscn.
7	const TRIGGER_FRAME := 10
8	const RETRIGGER_FRAME := 15
9	@export var retrigger := false
10	var frame := 0   # 0 on the first _process call, so frame N is the Nth image Movie Maker writes
11	@onready var puff_plate: GPUParticles2D = $PuffPlate
12	@onready var puff_table: GPUParticles2D = $PuffTable
13	@onready var puff_retrigger: GPUParticles2D = $PuffRetrigger
14	
15	func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
16		if frame == TRIGGER_FRAME:
17			puff_plate.emitting = true
18			puff_table.emitting = true
19		if retrigger and frame == RETRIGGER_FRAME:
20			puff_retrigger.emitting = true
21		frame += 1

1	extends Resource
2	## Jelly Hop slice: the one place for the open values of SLICE-BRIEF.md §9 and the art sizes.
3	## Values marked DEFAULT are build defaults, to be tuned in playtesting.
4	## Values marked DECIDED come from Kiran's decisions or the Batch 2 review; values marked
5	## MEASURED come from the art itself. Movement (speed, jump) lives in features/player/tuning.gd.
6	
7	# ---- Screen and table (Batch 2 review sizes) ----
8	const VIEW := Vector2(1280, 720)
9	const TABLE_TOP := 520.0                      ## DECIDED: 200 px table strip along the bottom
10	const TABLE_SCALE := 0.3378                   ## DECIDED: ENV-TABLE 592 px tall -> 200 px
11	const PLATE_SCALE := 0.1986                   ## DECIDED: plate 200 px wide
12	const SAUCE_SCALE := 0.1299                   ## DECIDED: sauce 120 x 19
13	const DOME_SCALE := 0.2452                    ## DECIDED: dome 180 x 128
14	const JELLY_SCALE := 0.1060                   ## DECIDED: resting cube 64 x 64
15	const JELLY_ANCHOR := Vector2(512, 812)       ## MEASURED: every pose's bottom edge is at y 811-812
16	
17	# ---- Plate art, measured from ENV-PLATE.png (rows are art pixels) ----
18	const PLATE_ART_BOTTOM_ROW := 144.0           ## MEASURED: last opaque row
19	const PLATE_ART_LANDING_ROW := 33.0           ## MEASURED: ~5 game px below the rim's top row 8
20	const PLATE_ART_LANDING_SPAN := Vector2(16, 1008)  ## MEASURED: opaque x range on the landing row
21	const PLATE_ART_CENTER_X := 511.5             ## MEASURED: centre of the drawn plate (8 + 1007 / 2)
22	
23	# ---- Fork (Kiran, 2026-10-03: the tines span the plate's full width; hit zone = visible tines) ----
24	const FORK_TINE_SPAN_PX := 200.0              ## DECIDED: visible tine span on screen
25	const FORK_TINE_ART_SPAN := Vector2(9, 326)   ## MEASURED: x range of the four tines in ENV-FORK.png
26	const FORK_RAISED_TIP_Y := 240.0              ## DEFAULT: tine tips while raised (above the jelly's hop peak)
27	
28	# ---- Level layout ----
29	const FIRST_PLATE_LEFT := 160.0               ## DEFAULT
30	const PLATE_GAPS := [120.0, 140.0, 150.0, 160.0, 170.0]  ## DEFAULT: edge to edge, plate 1 -> 6
31	const SAUCE_IN_GAP := [false, true, false, true, true]   ## DEFAULT: sauce in gaps 2, 4 and 5
32	const DOME_GAP := 150.0                       ## DEFAULT: bare table between plate 6 and the dome
33	const LEVEL_MARGIN_RIGHT := 250.0             ## DEFAULT: table beyond the dome
34	
35	# ---- Fork cycles, per plate (seconds). null = no fork. ----
36	## Each cycle: SAFE (raised) -> SHADOW (grows) -> STRIKE (down, hold, up) -> SAFE.
37	## offset = seconds into the cycle at the start of play (the cycle starts with the safe window).
38	## Forks on screen at the start begin in their safe window (offset < safe), so nothing warns at
39	## the start. Forks off screen at the start (plates 5 and 6) begin halfway into their shadow
40	## phase (offset = safe + shadow / 2), frozen during the intro pan, so the pan shows shadows
41	## as panel 1 lists (Kiran, 2026-10-03).
42	const FORK_CYCLES := [                        ## DEFAULT (all)
43		null,
44		{"shadow": 1.6, "safe": 2.2, "offset": 0.0},
45		{"shadow": 1.4, "safe": 1.9, "offset": 1.0},
46		{"shadow": 1.3, "safe": 1.6, "offset": 0.4},
47		{"shadow": 1.2, "safe": 1.4, "offset": 2.0},   # off screen at the start: mid-shadow
48		{"shadow": 1.0, "safe": 1.2, "offset": 1.7},   # off screen at the start: mid-shadow
49	]
50	const STRIKE_DOWN := 0.12                     ## DEFAULT
51	const STRIKE_HOLD := 0.30                     ## DEFAULT
52	const STRIKE_UP := 0.28                       ## DEFAULT
53	
54	# ---- Jelly timing ----
55	const BORED_DELAY := 4.0                      ## DEFAULT: seconds without input before the bored slump
56	const ANTIC_TICKS := 4                        ## DEFAULT: crouch pose at takeoff (visual only, no input delay)
57	const LAND_TICKS := 8                         ## DEFAULT: landing squash pose
58	const SCOOT_FRAME := 0.12                     ## DEFAULT: scoot A/B swap time
59	const SPLAT_TIME := 0.6                       ## DEFAULT
60	const REFORM_TIME := 0.7                      ## DEFAULT
61	const WIN_SLIDE := 0.3                        ## DEFAULT: slide to the dome's centre
62	const PROMPT_DELAY := 1.0                     ## DEFAULT: "press any key to play again" appears after this
63	
64	# ---- Camera ----
65	const INTRO_PAN := 4.0                        ## DEFAULT: dome -> jelly, ease in-out
66	const LOOK_AHEAD := 240.0                     ## DEFAULT: camera centre is this far right of the jelly
67	const CAMERA_SMOOTHING := 4.0                 ## DEFAULT: Camera2D smoothing speed (gives the respawn glide)
68	const SHAKE_PX := 8.0                         ## DEFAULT: fork splat only, camera offset only
69	const SHAKE_TIME := 0.25                      ## DEFAULT
70	
71	# ---- Music targets: volume dB on the Music bus, low-pass cutoff Hz (20500 = open) ----
72	const MUSIC := {                              ## DEFAULT (all)
73		"intro": {"db": -8.0, "cutoff": 20500.0},
74		"normal": {"db": 0.0, "cutoff": 20500.0},
75		"warning": {"db": -9.0, "cutoff": 900.0},
76		"splat": {"db": -12.0, "cutoff": 20500.0},
77		"pause": {"db": -20.0, "cutoff": 500.0},
78		"win_fade": {"db": -40.0, "cutoff": 20500.0},
79		"end_quiet": {"db": -40.0, "cutoff": 20500.0},
80	}
81	const MUSIC_RAMP := 0.25                      ## DEFAULT: seconds for a change of target
82	const WIN_FADE_TIME := 1.5                    ## DEFAULT
83	
84	# ---- Room ----
85	const ROOM_PARALLAX := false                  ## DEFAULT: static room; parallax only if approved
86	const ROOM_BRIGHTNESS := 1.0                  ## DEFAULT: unchanged; flagged for review
87	
88	# ---- Derived values ----
89	static func plate_lefts() -> Array[float]:
90		var out: Array[float] = [FIRST_PLATE_LEFT]
91		for gap in PLATE_GAPS:
92			out.append(out.back() + plate_width() + gap)
93		return out
94	
95	static func plate_width() -> float:  ## drawn width (1007 art px; the canvas adds an 8 px empty border)
96		return 1007.0 * PLATE_SCALE
97	
98	static func plate_landing_y() -> float:
99		return TABLE_TOP - (PLATE_ART_BOTTOM_ROW - PLATE_ART_LANDING_ROW) * PLATE_SCALE
100	
101	static func plate_landing_half_width() -> float:
102		return (PLATE_ART_LANDING_SPAN.y - PLATE_ART_LANDING_SPAN.x) * PLATE_SCALE / 2.0
103	
104	static func fork_scale() -> float:
105		return FORK_TINE_SPAN_PX / (FORK_TINE_ART_SPAN.y - FORK_TINE_ART_SPAN.x)
106	
107	static func dome_left() -> float:
108		return plate_lefts().back() + plate_width() + DOME_GAP
109	
110	static func dome_width() -> float:
111		return 750.0 * DOME_SCALE
112	
113	static func level_width() -> float:
114		return dome_left() + dome_width() + LEVEL_MARGIN_RIGHT
115	
116	static func ticks(seconds: float) -> int:
117		return int(round(seconds * 60.0))
118

const PLATE_ART_LANDING_SPAN := Vector2(16, 1008)  ## MEASURED: opaque x range on the landing row
const PLATE_ART_CENTER_X := 511.5             ## MEASURED: centre of the drawn plate (8 + 1007 / 2)

# ---- Fork (Kiran, 2026-10-03: the tines span the plate's full width; hit zone = visible tines) ----
const FORK_TINE_SPAN_PX := 200.0              ## DECIDED: visible tine span on screen
const FORK_TINE_ART_SPAN := Vector2(9, 326)   ## MEASURED: x range of the four tines in ENV-FORK.png
const FORK_RAISED_TIP_Y := 240.0              ## DEFAULT: tine tips while raised (above the jelly's hop peak)

# ---- Level layout ----
const FIRST_PLATE_LEFT := 160.0               ## DEFAULT
const PLATE_GAPS := [120.0, 140.0, 150.0, 160.0, 170.0]  ## DEFAULT: edge to edge, plate 1 -> 6
const SAUCE_IN_GAP := [false, true, false, true, true]   ## DEFAULT: sauce in gaps 2, 4 and 5
const DOME_GAP := 150.0                       ## DEFAULT: bare table between plate 6 and the dome
const LEVEL_MARGIN_RIGHT := 250.0             ## DEFAULT: table beyond the dome

# ---- Fork cycles, per plate (seconds). null = no fork. ----
## Each cycle: SAFE (raised) -> SHADOW (grows) -> STRIKE (down, hold, up) -> SAFE.
## offset = seconds into the cycle at the start of play (the cycle starts with the safe window).
## Forks on screen at the start begin in their safe window (offset < safe), so nothing warns at
## the start. Forks off screen at the start (plates 5 and 6) begin halfway into their shadow
## phase (offset = safe + shadow / 2), frozen during the intro pan, so the pan shows shadows
## as panel 1 lists (Kiran, 2026-10-03).
const FORK_CYCLES := [                        ## DEFAULT (all)
	null,
	{"shadow": 1.6, "safe": 2.2, "offset": 0.0},
	{"shadow": 1.4, "safe": 1.9, "offset": 1.0},
	{"shadow": 1.3, "safe": 1.6, "offset": 0.4},
	{"shadow": 1.2, "safe": 1.4, "offset": 2.0},   # off screen at the start: mid-shadow
	{"shadow": 1.0, "safe": 1.2, "offset": 1.7},   # off screen at the start: mid-shadow
]
const STRIKE_DOWN := 0.12                     ## DEFAULT
const STRIKE_HOLD := 0.30                     ## DEFAULT
const STRIKE_UP := 0.28                       ## DEFAULT

# ---- Jelly timing ----
const BORED_DELAY := 4.0                      ## DEFAULT: seconds without input before the bored slump
const ANTIC_TICKS := 4                        ## DEFAULT: crouch pose at takeoff (visual only, no input delay)
const LAND_TICKS := 8                         ## DEFAULT: landing squash pose
const SCOOT_FRAME := 0.12                     ## DEFAULT: scoot A/B swap time
const SPLAT_TIME := 0.6                       ## DEFAULT
const REFORM_TIME := 0.7                      ## DEFAULT
const WIN_SLIDE := 0.3                        ## DEFAULT: slide to the dome's centre
const PROMPT_DELAY := 1.0                     ## DEFAULT: "press any key to play again" appears after this

# ---- Camera ----
const INTRO_PAN := 4.0                        ## DEFAULT: dome -> jelly, ease in-out
const LOOK_AHEAD := 240.0                     ## DEFAULT: camera centre is this far right of the jelly
const CAMERA_SMOOTHING := 4.0                 ## DEFAULT: Camera2D smoothing speed (gives the respawn glide)
const SHAKE_PX := 8.0                         ## DEFAULT: fork splat only, camera offset only
const SHAKE_TIME := 0.25                      ## DEFAULT

# ---- Music targets: volume dB on the Music bus, low-pass cutoff Hz (20500 = open) ----
const MUSIC := {                              ## DEFAULT (all)
	"intro": {"db": -8.0, "cutoff": 20500.0},
	"normal": {"db": 0.0, "cutoff": 20500.0},
	"warning": {"db": -9.0, "cutoff": 900.0},
	"splat": {"db": -12.0, "cutoff": 20500.0},
	"pause": {"db": -20.0, "cutoff": 500.0},
	"win_fade": {"db": -40.0, "cutoff": 20500.0},
	"end_quiet": {"db": -40.0, "cutoff": 20500.0},
}
const MUSIC_RAMP := 0.25                      ## DEFAULT: seconds for a change of target
const WIN_FADE_TIME := 1.5                    ## DEFAULT

# ---- Room ----
const ROOM_PARALLAX := false                  ## DEFAULT: static room; parallax only if approved
const ROOM_BRIGHTNESS := 1.0                  ## DEFAULT: unchanged; flagged for review

# ---- Derived values ----
static func plate_lefts() -> Array[float]:
	var out: Array[float] = [FIRST_PLATE_LEFT]
	for gap in PLATE_GAPS:
		out.append(out.back() + plate_width() + gap)
	return out

static func plate_width() -> float:  ## drawn width (1007 art px; the canvas adds an 8 px empty border)
	return 1007.0 * PLATE_SCALE

static func plate_landing_y() -> float:
	return TABLE_TOP - (PLATE_ART_BOTTOM_ROW - PLATE_ART_LANDING_ROW) * PLATE_SCALE

static func plate_landing_half_width() -> float:
	return (PLATE_ART_LANDING_SPAN.y - PLATE_ART_LANDING_SPAN.x) * PLATE_SCALE / 2.0

static func fork_scale() -> float:
	return FORK_TINE_SPAN_PX / (FORK_TINE_ART_SPAN.y - FORK_TINE_ART_SPAN.x)

static func dome_left() -> float:
	return plate_lefts().back() + plate_width() + DOME_GAP

static func dome_width() -> float:
	return 750.0 * DOME_SCALE

static func level_width() -> float:
	return dome_left() + dome_width() + LEVEL_MARGIN_RIGHT

static func ticks(seconds: float) -> int:
	return int(round(seconds * 60.0))

134		TEST_RC=0

136		(cd "$WT" && ./scripts/run-test.sh "$test" 60) > /dev/null 2>&1 || TEST_RC=$?
137		TEST_LOG=""

158	row() {          # 11 tab-separated fields

160	}

162	ALL_AS_INTENDED=1
163	
164	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- M1-M3: one text change, one read-back
165	
166	# name file old new test intended_prefix intended_exact_line ("" if none)
167	mutation() {
168		local name="$1" file="$2" old="$3" new="$4" test="$5" want_prefix="$6" want_exact="$7"
169		local applied="no" import_col="n.a." actual="n.a." found="n.a." summary="n.a." verdict="" note=""
170		echo

172		add_worktree
173		local f="$WT/$file" n changed
174		if [ ! -f "$f" ]; then
175			verdict="SETUP FAILED"; note="$file not found in the worktree"
176		elif [ ! -f "$WT/godot/tests/$test" ]; then
177			verdict="SETUP FAILED"; note="godot/tests/$test not in HEAD"
178		else
179			n="$(count_of "$old" "$f")"
180			if [ "$n" != "1" ]; then
181				verdict="SETUP FAILED"; note="text not found: old text occurs $n times, exactly 1 required"
182			else
183				replace_once "$f" "$old" "$new"
184				changed="$(git -C "$WT" diff --name-only)"
185				git -C "$WT" diff > "$EV/${name}_diff.txt"
186				if [ "$(count_of "$old" "$f")" != "0" ] || [ "$(count_of "$new" "$f")" != "1" ] || [ "$changed" != "$file" ]; then
187					verdict="SETUP FAILED"; note="replacement not verified (changed files: ${changed:-none})"
188				else
189					applied="yes"
190				fi
191			fi
192		fi
193		if [ "$applied" = "yes" ]; then
194			do_import "$name"
195			import_col="$IMPORT_RC"
196			run_test "$name" "$test"
197			actual="$TEST_RC"
198			summary="$TEST_SUMMARY"

201				found="yes"
202				if [ -n "$want_exact" ] && ! has_exact_line "$want_exact" "$TEST_LOG"; then
203					found="no"
204				fi
205			fi
206			note="intended: '$want_prefix ...'"
207			if [ -n "$want_exact" ]; then

209			fi

212			elif [ "$TEST_RC" = "1" ] && [ "$found" = "yes" ]; then
213				verdict="CONFIRMED"
214			elif [ "$TEST_RC" = "0" ]; then

216			else
217				verdict="FAILED FOR ANOTHER REASON"
218			fi
219		fi
220		row "$name" "$file" "$applied" "$import_col" "$test" "1" "$actual" "$found" "$summary" "$verdict" "$note"
221		if [ "$verdict" != "CONFIRMED" ]; then

229	
230	fresh_cache() {

232		local import_col="n.a." actual="n.a." summary="n.a." verdict="" cache_before cache_after="n.a."
233		local reason="native rig: the loop modes are saved in the clip resources (land.tres LOOP_NONE; scoot.tres LOOP_LINEAR, the loop) and survive a fresh-cache import, unlike an imported clip edited in a scene"
234		local note="$reason"

236		echo "=== $name: fresh cache, no text change; tests $t1 and $t2"
237		add_worktree
238		cache_before="absent"
239		if [ -e "$WT/godot/.godot" ]; then
240			cache_before="present"
241		fi
242		if [ "$cache_before" != "absent" ]; then
243			verdict="SETUP FAILED"; note="godot/.godot exists in the fresh worktree, so the cache is not empty"
244		elif [ ! -f "$WT/godot/tests/$t1" ] || [ ! -f "$WT/godot/tests/$t2" ]; then
245			verdict="SETUP FAILED"; note="a read-back test is not in HEAD"
246		else
247			do_import "$name"
248			import_col="$IMPORT_RC"
249			cache_after="absent"
250			if [ -d "$WT/godot/.godot" ]; then
251				cache_after="present"
252			fi
253			run_test "$name" "$t1"
254			local rc1="$TEST_RC" s1="$TEST_SUMMARY"
255			run_test "$name" "$t2"
256			local rc2="$TEST_RC" s2="$TEST_SUMMARY"
257			actual="$rc1, $rc2"
258			summary="$s1 | $s2"
259			note="cache before import: $cache_before, after: $cache_after; $reason"
260			if [ "$IMPORT_OK" != "1" ]; then
261				verdict="IMPORT FAILED"
262			elif [ "$rc1" = "0" ] && [ "$rc2" = "0" ] && [[ "$s1" == *" / 0 failures" ]] && [[ "$s2" == *" / 0 failures" ]]; then
263				verdict="PASSED AS EXPECTED"
264			else
265				verdict="NOT AS EXPECTED"
266			fi
267		fi
268		row "$name" "none (fresh cache)" "n.a. (no change)" "$import_col" "$t1 + $t2" "0, 0" "$actual" "n.a." "$summary" "$verdict" "$note"
269		if [ "$verdict" != "PASSED AS EXPECTED" ]; then
270			ALL_AS_INTENDED=0
271		fi
272		echo "$name verdict: $verdict"
273		remove_worktree
274	}
275	
276	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- run
277	
278	{
279		echo "# A7 mutations and fresh import (sessions/a7/mutations.sh)"
280		echo "# run: $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)  HEAD: $HEAD_SHA  godot: $GODOT_VERSION"
281		echo "# worktree: $WT (detached, from HEAD; removed after each mutation)"
282		echo "# Each test: ./scripts/run-test.sh <test> 60 inside the worktree. Import: godot --headless --path godot --import."
283		echo "# CONFIRMED = import succeeded, test exit 1, and its log contains the intended FAIL line."
284		printf 'name\tfile\tapplied\timport_exit\ttest\texpected_exit\tactual_exit\tintended_fail_line_found\tsummary_line\tverdict\tnote\n'
285	} > "$EV/summary.txt"
286	: > "$EV/fail_lines.txt"
287	
288	mutation M1 "godot/animations/land.tres" "UpperPivot:position" "UpperPivot:positon" "test_a7_land_readback.gd" \
289		"FAIL every track of every clip resolves (track_problems):" \
290		"  track problem: land track 1: UpperPivot has no property positon"
291	
292	mutation M2 "godot/animations/scoot.tres" "loop_mode = 1" "loop_mode = 0" "test_a7_scoot_readback.gd" \
293		"FAIL loop_mode LOOP_LINEAR:" ""
294	
295	mutation M3 "godot/animations/scoot.tres" '"values": [0, 1]' '"values": [0, 2]' "test_a7_scoot_readback.gd" \
296		"FAIL every frame key in 0..hframes*vframes-1:" ""
297	
298	fresh_cache
299	
300	echo
301	echo "===== $EV/summary.txt"
302	cat "$EV/summary.txt"
303	if [ "$ALL_AS_INTENDED" != "1" ]; then
304		echo "RESULT: at least one mutation did not behave as intended (see verdicts above)." >&2
305		exit 1
306	fi
307	echo "RESULT: M1-M3 CONFIRMED, M4 PASSED AS EXPECTED."

	LC_ALL=C sed -e $'s/\033\\[[0-9;]*m//g' "$1"
}

count_of() {     # number of occurrences of literal text $1 in file $2
	local n
	n="$( { grep -o -F -- "$1" "$2" || true; } | wc -l | tr -d '[:space:]')"
	echo "$n"
}

replace_once() { # file old new: replaces the single occurrence (count checked by the caller); keeps trailing newlines
	local f="$1" old="$2" new="$3" content prefix suffix
	content="$(cat -- "$f"; printf x)"
	content="${content%x}"
	prefix="${content%%"$old"*}"
	suffix="${content#*"$old"}"
	printf '%s' "$prefix$new$suffix" > "$f"
}

has_prefix_line() { # prefix file: a line starting with the prefix exists
	strip_ansi "$2" | awk -v p="$1" 'index($0, p) == 1 { f = 1 } END { exit (f ? 0 : 1) }'
}

has_exact_line() {  # line file: exactly this line exists
	strip_ansi "$2" | awk -v p="$1" '$0 == p { f = 1 } END { exit (f ? 0 : 1) }'
}

remove_worktree() {
	git -C "$REPO" worktree remove --force "$WT"
	if [ -e "$WT" ]; then
		echo "STOPPED: $WT still exists after git worktree remove --force" >&2
		exit 1
	fi
}

add_worktree() {
	git -C "$REPO" worktree add --detach "$WT" HEAD
}

IMPORT_RC=""
IMPORT_OK=0
do_import() {    # name: import in the worktree; output to evidence/a7-mutations/<name>_import.txt
	local out="$EV/$1_import.txt" bad
	IMPORT_RC=0
	(cd "$WT" && timeout 600 godot --headless --path godot --import) > "$out" 2>&1 || IMPORT_RC=$?
	bad="$( { strip_ansi "$out" | grep -cE 'Failed loading resource|SCRIPT ERROR'; } || true)"
	IMPORT_OK=1
	if [ "$IMPORT_RC" != "0" ] || [ "$bad" != "0" ]; then
		IMPORT_OK=0
	fi
	echo "$1 import: exit $IMPORT_RC, 'Failed loading resource'/'SCRIPT ERROR' lines: $bad"
}

TEST_RC=""
TEST_LOG=""
TEST_SUMMARY=""
run_test() {     # name test: runs the worktree's wrapper at 60 fps and copies its log to evidence
	local name="$1" test="$2" base wlog
	base="${test%.gd}"
	wlog="$WT/logs/${base}_60fps.log"
	rm -f "$wlog"   # in the throwaway worktree only: never copy a committed log by mistake
	TEST_RC=0
	# The wrapper tees the full output into its own log, which is copied below.
	(cd "$WT" && ./scripts/run-test.sh "$test" 60) > /dev/null 2>&1 || TEST_RC=$?
	TEST_LOG=""
	TEST_SUMMARY="none"
	if [ -f "$wlog" ]; then
		TEST_LOG="$EV/${name}_${base}_60fps.log"
		cp "$wlog" "$TEST_LOG"
		local s
		s="$( { strip_ansi "$TEST_LOG" | grep -E '^A7 (LAND|SCOOT) READBACK: [0-9]+ checks / [0-9]+ failures'; } || true)"
		if [ -n "$s" ]; then
			TEST_SUMMARY="$s"
		fi
		{
			echo "## $name $test (wrapper exit $TEST_RC)"
			{ strip_ansi "$TEST_LOG" | grep -E '^FAIL |^  track problem: '; } || echo "(no FAIL lines)"
			echo
		} >> "$EV/fail_lines.txt"
	else
		echo "## $name $test (wrapper exit $TEST_RC): NO LOG at $wlog" >> "$EV/fail_lines.txt"
	fi
	echo "$name $test: wrapper exit $TEST_RC; $TEST_SUMMARY"
}

row() {          # 11 tab-separated fields
	printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$@" >> "$EV/summary.txt"
}

ALL_AS_INTENDED=1

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- M1-M3: one text change, one read-back

# name file old new test intended_prefix intended_exact_line ("" if none)
mutation() {
	local name="$1" file="$2" old="$3" new="$4" test="$5" want_prefix="$6" want_exact="$7"
	local applied="no" import_col="n.a." actual="n.a." found="n.a." summary="n.a." verdict="" note=""
	echo
	echo "=== $name: $file: '$old' -> '$new'; test $test"
	add_worktree
	local f="$WT/$file" n changed
	if [ ! -f "$f" ]; then
		verdict="SETUP FAILED"; note="$file not found in the worktree"
	elif [ ! -f "$WT/godot/tests/$test" ]; then
		verdict="SETUP FAILED"; note="godot/tests/$test not in HEAD"
	else
		n="$(count_of "$old" "$f")"
		if [ "$n" != "1" ]; then
			verdict="SETUP FAILED"; note="text not found: old text occurs $n times, exactly 1 required"
		else
			replace_once "$f" "$old" "$new"
			changed="$(git -C "$WT" diff --name-only)"
			git -C "$WT" diff > "$EV/${name}_diff.txt"
			if [ "$(count_of "$old" "$f")" != "0" ] || [ "$(count_of "$new" "$f")" != "1" ] || [ "$changed" != "$file" ]; then
				verdict="SETUP FAILED"; note="replacement not verified (changed files: ${changed:-none})"
			else
				applied="yes"
			fi
		fi
	fi
	if [ "$applied" = "yes" ]; then
		do_import "$name"
		import_col="$IMPORT_RC"
		run_test "$name" "$test"
		actual="$TEST_RC"
		summary="$TEST_SUMMARY"
		found="no"
		if [ -n "$TEST_LOG" ] && has_prefix_line "$want_prefix" "$TEST_LOG"; then
			found="yes"
			if [ -n "$want_exact" ] && ! has_exact_line "$want_exact" "$TEST_LOG"; then
				found="no"
			fi
		fi
		note="intended: '$want_prefix ...'"
		if [ -n "$want_exact" ]; then
			note="$note and '$want_exact'"
		fi
		if [ "$IMPORT_OK" != "1" ]; then
			verdict="IMPORT FAILED"; note="$note; import failed, test result not counted"
		elif [ "$TEST_RC" = "1" ] && [ "$found" = "yes" ]; then
			verdict="CONFIRMED"
		elif [ "$TEST_RC" = "0" ]; then
			verdict="NOT AS EXPECTED"; note="$note; the test passed, so the mutation was not caught"
		else
			verdict="FAILED FOR ANOTHER REASON"
		fi
	fi
	row "$name" "$file" "$applied" "$import_col" "$test" "1" "$actual" "$found" "$summary" "$verdict" "$note"
	if [ "$verdict" != "CONFIRMED" ]; then
		ALL_AS_INTENDED=0
	fi
	echo "$name verdict: $verdict"
	remove_worktree
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- M4: fresh cache, no change, both read-backs

fresh_cache() {
	local name="M4" t1="test_a7_land_readback.gd" t2="test_a7_scoot_readback.gd"
	local import_col="n.a." actual="n.a." summary="n.a." verdict="" cache_before cache_after="n.a."
	local reason="native rig: the loop modes are saved in the clip resources (land.tres LOOP_NONE; scoot.tres LOOP_LINEAR, the loop) and survive a fresh-cache import, unlike an imported clip edited in a scene"
	local note="$reason"
	echo
	echo "=== $name: fresh cache, no text change; tests $t1 and $t2"
	add_worktree
	cache_before="absent"
	if [ -e "$WT/godot/.godot" ]; then
		cache_before="present"
	fi
	if [ "$cache_before" != "absent" ]; then
		verdict="SETUP FAILED"; note="godot/.godot exists in the fresh worktree, so the cache is not empty"
	elif [ ! -f "$WT/godot/tests/$t1" ] || [ ! -f "$WT/godot/tests/$t2" ]; then
		verdict="SETUP FAILED"; note="a read-back test is not in HEAD"
	else
		do_import "$name"
		import_col="$IMPORT_RC"
		cache_after="absent"
		if [ -d "$WT/godot/.godot" ]; then
			cache_after="present"
		fi
		run_test "$name" "$t1"
		local rc1="$TEST_RC" s1="$TEST_SUMMARY"
		run_test "$name" "$t2"
		local rc2="$TEST_RC" s2="$TEST_SUMMARY"
		actual="$rc1, $rc2"
		summary="$s1 | $s2"
		note="cache before import: $cache_before, after: $cache_after; $reason"
		if [ "$IMPORT_OK" != "1" ]; then
			verdict="IMPORT FAILED"
		elif [ "$rc1" = "0" ] && [ "$rc2" = "0" ] && [[ "$s1" == *" / 0 failures" ]] && [[ "$s2" == *" / 0 failures" ]]; then
			verdict="PASSED AS EXPECTED"
		else
			verdict="NOT AS EXPECTED"
		fi
	fi
	row "$name" "none (fresh cache)" "n.a. (no change)" "$import_col" "$t1 + $t2" "0, 0" "$actual" "n.a." "$summary" "$verdict" "$note"
	if [ "$verdict" != "PASSED AS EXPECTED" ]; then
		ALL_AS_INTENDED=0
	fi
	echo "$name verdict: $verdict"
	remove_worktree
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- run

{
	echo "# A7 mutations and fresh import (sessions/a7/mutations.sh)"
	echo "# run: $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)  HEAD: $HEAD_SHA  godot: $GODOT_VERSION"
	echo "# worktree: $WT (detached, from HEAD; removed after each mutation)"
	echo "# Each test: ./scripts/run-test.sh <test> 60 inside the worktree. Import: godot --headless --path godot --import."
	echo "# CONFIRMED = import succeeded, test exit 1, and its log contains the intended FAIL line."
	printf 'name\tfile\tapplied\timport_exit\ttest\texpected_exit\tactual_exit\tintended_fail_line_found\tsummary_line\tverdict\tnote\n'
} > "$EV/summary.txt"
: > "$EV/fail_lines.txt"

mutation M1 "godot/animations/land.tres" "UpperPivot:position" "UpperPivot:positon" "test_a7_land_readback.gd" \
	"FAIL every track of every clip resolves (track_problems):" \
	"  track problem: land track 1: UpperPivot has no property positon"

mutation M2 "godot/animations/scoot.tres" "loop_mode = 1" "loop_mode = 0" "test_a7_scoot_readback.gd" \
	"FAIL loop_mode LOOP_LINEAR:" ""

mutation M3 "godot/animations/scoot.tres" '"values": [0, 1]' '"values": [0, 2]' "test_a7_scoot_readback.gd" \
	"FAIL every frame key in 0..hframes*vframes-1:" ""

fresh_cache

echo
echo "===== $EV/summary.txt"
cat "$EV/summary.txt"
if [ "$ALL_AS_INTENDED" != "1" ]; then
	echo "RESULT: at least one mutation did not behave as intended (see verdicts above)." >&2
	exit 1
fi
echo "RESULT: M1-M3 CONFIRMED, M4 PASSED AS EXPECTED."

72	func key_for(read_tick: int, code: Key, pressed: bool) -> void:
73		## Schedules a key event so the player's _physics_process reads it on physics frame read_tick.
74		## Must be called no later than the start of frame read_tick - 1.
75		if now() > read_tick - 1:
76			check("harness-input-scheduled-in-time", false, {"read_tick": read_tick, "now": now(), "key": OS.get_keycode_string(code)})

80		## The game's InputMap holds InputEventKey events with physical_keycode (session.gd lines 73-76).
81		var event := InputEventKey.new()
82		event.keycode = code

88		# the flush it is applied now, during physics frame now(); Godot then reports it as just pressed on
